battle.name: 後凱薩時代的內戰
battle.theater: 希臘馬其頓腓立比戰場
battle.brief: 公元前四十四年三月凱撒遇刺，羅馬分裂為刺殺者與遺囑繼承者。前四十三年布魯圖斯與卡西烏斯在希臘募兵，前四十二年冬渡海奪取意大利軍團，同年十月在馬其頓腓立比與安東尼、屋大維兩度交鋒。卡面科林斯青銅盔早已退出戰列，它象徵的密閉方陣卻由布魯圖斯的縱深陣線繼承，一翼先散便全線瓦解。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 這場內戰爆發於公元前四十四年三月凱撒在龐培劇院被刺之後，交戰的兩大主體是解放者聯盟與第二次三頭同盟。解放者一方由馬可·尤尼烏斯·布魯圖斯與蓋烏斯·卡西烏斯·隆基努斯領銜：前四十四年布魯圖斯在意大利招募兵員並拉攏願意支持共和的軍團，卡西烏斯則以敘利亞、奇里乞亞與卡帕多細亞行省總督的身分在東方籌措軍資；前四十二年兩人先後離開意大利，在馬其頓、希臘與小亞細亞收攏散兵，掌控第西比亞與馬其頓的希臘城市，並取得小亞細亞的稅收，其軍隊以羅馬軍團為骨幹、希臘與色雷斯雇傭兵為輔，戰時編制為十四個軍團加多支外籍輔助隊。三頭同盟一方由馬可·安東尼、蓋烏斯·屋大維與瑪爾庫斯·雷必達組成，前四十三年十一月二十七日依《提提亞法》取得五年非常統治權，握有意大利本土、餘下的西班牙、高盧與非洲的稅源，並以公敵宣告清洗反對陣營。海上還有西克斯都·龐培的殘部控制西西里、撒丁島與地中海中部航路；東邊有埃及托勒密王朝與帕提亞帝國在資金與邊境上替各方加碼。雙方的指揮系統都建立在共和國的執政官與元老院程序之上，但真正決定會戰的，是將軍個人帶來的行省稅收、隨軍糧草與老兵軍團的效忠。
countriesEn: The civil war broke out in March 44 BC, when Caesar was stabbed in the Theatre of Pompey, and its two main antagonists were the Liberators and the Second Triumvirate. The Liberators were headed by Marcus Junius Brutus and Gaius Cassius Longinus: in 44 BC Brutus recruited in Italy and won over legions inclined to the republican cause, while Cassius, as governor of Syria, Cilicia and Cappadocia, raised money in the eastern provinces; in 42 BC the two left Italy in turn, gathered stragglers in Macedonia, Greece and Asia Minor, took control of the Greek cities of Thessaly and Macedonia, and drew on the revenues of Asia Minor. Their army had the Roman legion as its skeleton, with Greek and Thracian mercenaries in support, and on the eve of the battle it stood as fourteen legions with a number of foreign auxiliary units. The Triumvirate side consisted of Mark Antony, Gaius Octavius and Marcus Lepidus; on 27 November 43 BC the three obtained five years of extraordinary power under the Lex Titia, held Italy proper together with the remaining provinces of Spain, Gaul and Africa, and used the proscription lists to purge their opponents. At sea, the surviving forces of Sextus Pompey controlled Sicily, Sardinia and the central Mediterranean lanes; to the east, the Ptolemaic kingdom of Egypt and the Parthian Empire added money and pressure to the sides. Both chains of command rested on the republican offices of consul and the formalities of the senate, but what actually decided a pitched battle was the provincial revenue a general brought with him, the grain and pay that travelled with the army, and the loyalty of the veteran legions.
people: 決定這場內戰走向的人幾乎全部死在會戰或自盡。凱撒前四十四年三月十五日被刺，他的遺囑把繼承權指定給十六歲的姪孫屋大維，指定安東尼等數人為遺囑執行人並要他們照顧幼子，這份遺囑同時把分散的行省稅收與軍隊的效忠一併交了出去，等於內戰的產權憑證。布魯圖斯與卡西烏斯是最後一批能憑元老院信譽集兵的人：卡西烏斯前四十八年以敘利亞總督身份打平帕提亞，手握羅馬最富的行省財源，又以出兵的經驗與一批久經沙場的老兵見長；布魯圖斯靠清廉與演說爭取到十四個軍團，並在馬其頓成功招募希臘人、塞薩利人與色雷斯人。馬可·安東尼出身騎士家族，前四十四年出任執政官，前四十二年在西西里與塞克斯都·龐培的據點對峙而屢攻不下，最終在腓立比之前被迫放棄意大利。屋大維年輕而手腕老辣，以遺囑繼承人的名義接管三頭同盟的西半部，前四十三年冬天以圍城戰攻破安東尼的兄長路基烏斯與福爾維婭。瑪爾庫斯·雷必達掌握第三支軍隊，卻在腓立比戰役中毫無作用。另外，德奇穆斯·布魯圖斯率解放者左翼並在首戰中遭重創，加利奧率三頭同盟左翼卻敗在卡西烏斯手上，這兩場局部敗績直接改變了整個戰局。
peopleEn: Nearly every man who shaped this civil war died in battle or by his own hand. Caesar was killed on 15 March 44 BC, and his will named his sixteen-year-old grand-nephew Octavius as heir and named Antony and several others as executors, asking them to look after the boy; the same will handed out the dispersed provincial revenues and the loyalties of the legions, and so it served as the title deed of the coming civil war. Brutus and Cassius were the last men able to raise an army on the credit of the senate. Cassius, governor of Syria in 48 BC, had ended the Parthian war and controlled the richest provincial revenue in the empire, and he was renowned for the experience of his campaigning veterans. Brutus, by his reputation for incorruptibility and his oratory, won over fourteen legions, and in Macedonia he enlisted Greeks, Thessalians and Thracians. Mark Antony, a man of equestrian family, was consul in 44 BC; in 42 BC he was stuck in Sicily facing the stronghold of Sextus Pompey and could not take it, and he was forced to abandon Italy before Philippi. Octavius was young but cunning: on the strength of the will he took over the western half of the Triumvirate, and in the winter of 43 BC he reduced Antony's brother Lucius and Fulvia by siege at Perusia. Marcus Lepidus commanded the third army and played no part at all in the battle of Philippi. Two local actions also mattered: Decimus Brutus commanded the left wing of the Liberators and was badly mauled in the first engagement, while Gallus commanded the left wing of the Triumvirate and was beaten by Cassius, and these two defeats changed the course of the whole war.
kits: 卡面這頂科林斯青銅盔造於公元前六百五十年前後，是全開眼、帶鼻樑與頰甲的希臘青銅頭盔，代表密集隊形時代個人防護的頂點：它擋得住正面揮砍，卻把視野鎖死在正前方，戴上它的重裝步兵只能靠身旁的同袍與腳下的列線活下去。科林斯是這一形制的產地名，考古出土的希臘化時期青銅頭盔裏仍可見同一樣式沿用。到了公元前四十二年，這種頭盔已傳世六百餘年，在希臘與馬其頓的雇傭兵中仍有配發，也被將領與貴族當作戰利品收藏，但它早已不是羅馬軍團的制式裝備。真正上戰場的羅馬步兵裝備是另外一套：圓弓形大盾、西班牙式短劍、一至兩支標槍與一把輕便投槍；軍團中的弓箭手多為外籍，克里特弓手用輕角弓配黑尾箭，敘利亞弓手用能發射標槍式箭的重弓，巴利阿里投石索手負責騷擾色雷斯與達利亞的遊擊隊；投射武器包括配重式投石機、手拉式弩砲與大型弩砲，發射標槍式箭的射程約在一百五十至二百米之間。騎兵是這場戰役的重心之一，解放者的騎兵多為色雷斯與塞薩利騎手，裝備小圓盾與雙刃騎槍；三頭同盟一方的騎兵以羅馬軍團騎隊和意大利同盟騎兵組成。營地則按波利比奧斯的制度逐日挖壕築壘，士兵自帶三十公斤上下的全套裝備與口糧，行李與盛在陶罐裏的穀物酒靠騾車運載。
kitsEn: The Corinthian helmet on the card was made around 650 BC: a Greek bronze helmet with a full opening for the eyes, a nasal and cheek pieces. It represents the high point of personal protection in the age of dense formation, stopping a frontal blow but locking the wearer's vision to a narrow forward cone, so that the heavy infantryman wearing it could only stay alive through the man at his shoulder and the line at his feet. Corinth was the production place of the type, and bronze helmets of the same shape are still attested in the Hellenistic period. By 42 BC the helmet was over six centuries old: it was still issued to some Greek and Macedonian mercenaries, and generals and nobles kept such pieces as trophies, but it had long ceased to be standard kit for a Roman legion. The equipment that actually went to war in the Roman infantry was a different set: the curved rectangular scutum, the Spanish-style gladius, one or two heavy javelins and a light throwing spear. Most of the archers in a legion were foreigners, Cretan bowmen with light composite bows and barbed arrows, Syrian archers with heavy bows that could loose a javelin-sized bolt, and Balearic slingers harrying Thracian and Dalmatian raiders. The artillery of the age comprised traction and counterweight stone-throwers and bolt-shooting engines, the heavy onagrinx and the lighter cheiroballistra, whose bolts carried roughly a hundred and fifty to two hundred metres. Cavalry was one of the decisive arms of this campaign: the Liberator horse was largely Thracian and Thessalian, armed with small round shields and two-edged cavalry lances, while the Triumvirate mounted troops were Roman squadron cavalry supplemented by Italian allied horsemen. On the march, the camp was dug and ramparded each day following the Polybian layout, the legionary carried some thirty kilograms of weapons and kit plus his rations, and the baggage with grain and wine in earthenware jars was moved by mule cart.
tactics: 腓立比的地形決定了一切：兩片山脊夾著一片開闊平原，解放者各佔一側高地築營，中間有克雷尼德斯泉水與安吉提斯河，縱深不過數里，任何調動都會立刻被對方看見。前四十二年十月三日首戰，解放者以卡西烏斯的右翼、布魯圖斯的中軍與德奇穆斯·布魯圖斯的左翼對上三頭同盟的加利奧、屋大維與安東尼；卡西烏斯右肩中劍被抬下戰場，他的營帳隨後被攻破，安東尼當日帶病躺在擔架上指揮，擔架與護衛被奪，屋大維的中軍被色雷斯兵與底比斯兵突破，解放者一度以少兵取得戰果，卻因營地被奪而無法擴展戰果。十月六日再戰，布魯圖斯把主力組成縱深二十列的方陣，這正是最古老、也最符合科林斯青銅盔時代軍事哲學的部署：以密集的盾牌牆承受衝擊，靠整列同時進退維持士氣；安東尼的騎兵與兩翼的色雷斯兵、弓手在方陣推進時先一步潰散，屋大維的左翼幾乎被衝垮，方陣追擊到卡西烏斯的營地時力竭，隊形在看似勝利的時刻瓦解。此外還有更早的兩段：前四十三年冬天的佩魯賈之圍，三頭同盟以壕溝與圍牆斷絕城內糧水，熬過嚴冬迫其放棄；解放者渡海回到意大利後，強徵富豪稅以籌措軍費，並許諾以沒收的產地安置退伍兵。行軍與補給同樣是戰術的一部分：全軍每日行程約二十羅馬里（約三十公里），沿途按營地制度宿營，糧食靠船隊運來，任何一次登岸延誤都會改變會戰日期。
tacticsEn: The ground at Philippi settled everything. Two ridges enclose an open plain, the Liberators each holding a height and camp on one of them, with the spring of Krenides and the river Angitis between, and the whole field was only a few kilometres deep, so that any movement was seen at once by the enemy. In the first engagement, on 3 October 42 BC, the Liberators matched Cassius on the right, Brutus in the centre and Decimus Brutus on the left against Gallus, Octavius and Antony of the Triumvirate. Cassius took a sword blow on the right shoulder and was carried off the field, and his camp was then overrun; Antony fought that day while ill, carried into the line on a litter, and both the litter and its bearer were lost. Octavius's centre was broken by Thracian and Theban troops, and the Liberators for a moment won with fewer men, but the loss of the camp stopped them from pressing the advantage. On 6 October they fought again, and Brutus formed his main body into a phalanx twenty cohorts deep, the oldest deployment and the one that best matched the military philosophy of the Corinthian helmet's age: a wall of shields absorbing the impact, the line kept alive by all its files advancing and withdrawing together. Antony's cavalry, and the Thracian and archer auxiliaries on both wings, gave way as the phalanx advanced; Octavius's left was almost overrun, and the phalanx, in its pursuit towards Cassius's camp, spent itself, so that the formation dissolved at the very moment that looked like victory. Two earlier episodes belong to the same campaign: the siege of Perusia in the winter of 43 BC, where the Triumvirate cut the town's grain and water with ditch and circumvallation and waited out the hard cold until it surrendered; and the Liberators' return to Italy, where a levy on the wealthy furnished the army's pay and the confiscated estates were promised to the veterans. Marching and supply were tactical in their own right: the column covered about twenty Roman miles a day, some thirty kilometres, camping each night on the Polybian plan, and the grain came by sea, so that any delay in landing could move the date of a battle.
data: 可以核對的數字集中在兵力、日期與裝備三端。共和國末期的軍團約四千八百至五千名步兵，另有約一百二十名騎兵；布魯圖斯在馬其頓統有十四個軍團，腓立比前線解放者一方的總兵力各家記載分歧極大，多數學者認為實際落在數萬到十萬之間；三頭同盟一方投入會戰的部隊約兩萬步兵與六千騎兵，其中相當部分是新募而缺乏經驗的新兵，安東尼的大量軍團因西克斯都·龐培的海上威脅而無法西進。會戰日期一般定於公元前四十二年十月三日與十月六日，部分學者依羅馬曆與節氣推算為九月三十日與十月三日；腓立比距馬其頓城約十五公里，兩次會戰相隔三日。裝備方面，全套羅馬步兵裝備約三十公斤，標槍有效射程約三十米，弩砲發射標槍式箭約一百五十至二百米，配重投石機可把石彈送出三百米以上；軍團營區按制度為半英里見方，環壕深數米。戰後的損失以萬計，解放者全軍覆沒；屋大維解散並重編解放者的軍團，最終在治下維持二十八個常備軍團，蘇埃托尼烏斯記其總兵力約十二萬人上下。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are concentrated in three places: numbers of troops, dates, and equipment. A legion of the late republic carried about four thousand eight hundred to five thousand foot and a further hundred and twenty horse; Brutus commanded fourteen legions in Macedonia. The total strength of the Liberator force at Philippi differs enormously between the sources, and most scholars put it somewhere between tens of thousands and a hundred thousand. The Triumvirate committed roughly twenty thousand foot and six thousand horse to the field, a large part of them newly raised and untrained, while the bulk of Antony's legions could not move west because of the sea threat from Sextus Pompey. The two engagements are usually dated to 3 and 6 October 42 BC, though some scholars, working from the Roman calendar and the season, prefer 30 September and 3 October. Philippi lies about fifteen kilometres from the city of Macedon, and the two battles were three days apart. On equipment: a Roman infantryman's full kit weighed some thirty kilograms; the heavy javelin had an effective range of about thirty metres; bolt engines threw their bolts roughly a hundred and fifty to two hundred metres; counterweight throwers carried stone over three hundred metres. The legionary camp was by regulation half a mile square with a ditch several metres deep. Losses ran into the tens of thousands, and the Liberator army was destroyed; Octavius disbanded and re-enlisted the broken legions and in the end maintained twenty-eight standing legions, Suetonius putting the whole force at around a hundred and twenty thousand men.
cause: 直接起因是公元前四十四年三月十五日龐培劇院的那場刺殺。策動者是凱撒的政敵與一批主張廢除獨裁、恢復共和的元老，布魯圖斯、卡西烏斯等人的理由是凱撒終身獨裁與自稱神號已使共和國名存實亡，刺殺者以自己的性命作籌碼，原打算恢復執政官與元老院的舊制。事後形勢急轉直下：凱撒許諾給各軍團的軍餉與退伍金成了爭奪的實物，軍隊四散在行省，誰能接管軍團誰就掌握國家；屋大維憑遺囑繼承與遺囑執行人的名義瓜分政權，前四十三年第二次三頭同盟成立，《佩迪亞法》公佈追害名單，解放者一方被定性為公敵，於是原本爭的是制度路線，變成爭同一批軍團與同一批稅收。第三重原因是資源與地理的分配：意大利的稅源與海運航路掌握在三頭同盟手中，東方的小亞細亞財富落在解放者手中；塞克斯都·龐培的艦隊控制地中海中部，迫使安東尼無法西進，這使腓立比的會戰在開打之前就已註定三頭同盟必須以少兵迎戰，而少兵迎戰正是方陣最擅長的局面。
causeEn: The proximate cause was the assassination in the Theatre of Pompey on 15 March 44 BC. Those who set it in motion were Caesar's political enemies and a group of senators who held that his permanent dictatorship and his divine titles had left the republic a name without a substance, and they risked their own lives in the belief that the offices of consul and the authority of the senate could be restored. What followed made a shambles of that intention: the pay and the discharge money Caesar had promised to the legions became physical objects of contention, the legions were scattered across the provinces, and whoever could take hold of an army held the state. Octavius, on the strength of the will and of the executorship, divided the government with his partners; the Second Triumvirate was formed in 43 BC; the Lex Pedia published the proscription lists and the Liberators were declared public enemies. What had begun as a quarrel over the form of the constitution turned into a fight over the same legions and the same taxes. A third cause lay in the geography of resources: the tax revenues of Italy and the sea lanes were in the hands of the Triumvirate, while the wealth of Asia Minor lay with the Liberators. The fleet of Sextus Pompey held the middle Mediterranean and pinned Antony in the west, so that Philippi was fought from the start as a battle in which the Triumvirate had to meet superior numbers, and a battle in which the phalanx was at its strongest.
impact: 腓立比之後，共和國的制度被徹底清空。解放者派覆亡，安東尼的西線崩解，意大利境內不再有能組軍反對的勢力，元老院從此只剩形式；第二次三頭同盟以非常權力沒收財產、拆毀房屋，按人口徵收所謂富豪稅，把意大利的資本與人力重新分配，同時把戰爭負擔轉給還鄉農兵。軍制上，腓立比敗者留下的軍團被收編重編，屋大維最終以二十八個常備軍團取代徵召制，羅馬從公民兵制轉為依賴邊疆常備軍的帝國財政機器，退役老兵安置與土地集中成為內戰留下的社會難題。東地中海的格局也被改寫：安東尼把勢力伸進埃及與亞美尼亞，羅馬與帕提亞的邊界從此成為長期前線；希臘世界在腓立比之後失去最後一次以城邦聯盟左右羅馬內政的能力，科林斯青銅盔所代表的密集方陣哲學在羅馬軍制中徹底退場，此後的步兵戰術以投射武器、線性縱隊與長矛方陣為主流。凱撒之死本想恢復共和，最後交到皇帝手上的卻是常備軍與個人效忠這兩件東西。
impactEn: After Philippi the institutions of the republic were emptied out. The Liberators were destroyed, Antony's western front collapsed, and no power inside Italy could any longer raise an army in opposition; the senate survived as a form. The Second Triumvirate used its extraordinary powers to confiscate property and pull down houses, levied a tax on the wealthy, redistributed the capital and labour of Italy, and shifted the burden of the war onto the peasant soldiers sent home. Militarily, the broken legions of the defeated were re-enlisted, and Octavius eventually replaced the levy system with twenty-eight standing legions; Rome passed from a citizen militia to the fiscal machine of an empire resting on frontier armies, and the settlement of discharged veterans and the concentration of land became the standing social problem left behind by the war. The eastern Mediterranean was redrawn as well: Antony's reach into Egypt and Armenia made the Roman-Parthian frontier a permanent line, and Greece, after Philippi, lost the last of its ability to influence Roman politics through its city leagues. The dense phalanx philosophy typified by the Corinthian helmet left the Roman order of battle for good, and infantry fighting for the next two thousand years ran on missile troops, linear formations and the long pike. Caesar's murder was meant to save the republic; what it handed to the emperors instead was the standing army and personal loyalty.
result: 公元前四十二年十月六日的第二次腓立比會戰，解散了解放者的聯軍。方陣在追擊卡西烏斯營地時力竭，兩翼的色雷斯兵、弓手與三頭同盟的騎兵早已離開戰場，失去遮蔽的縱深隊形在推進中自我瓦解；卡西烏斯與布魯圖斯相繼自盡，屍首被投入安吉提斯河，解放者的將佐被列為公敵，軍隊被解散或收編，馬其頓與希臘城市重回三頭同盟的統治。結果並非一方全勝：安東尼的西線同樣被削弱，他放棄意大利，帶著殘餘軍隊東行，前四十一年之後掌控羅馬的東方；屋大維留著二十八個軍團，於前三十七年取得執政官權，前三十六年的米利與瑙洛庫斯海戰封死塞克斯都·龐培，前三十一年九月二日亞克興海戰再勝安東尼，前三十年埃及落入屋大維手中。回頭看，這場始於公元前四十四年三月的內戰真正解決的，是誰能繼承凱撒這個問題：答案是握有軍隊與意大利稅源的那一方，共和的名字則在腓立比的平原上退場。
resultEn: The second battle of Philippi, fought on 6 October 42 BC, dissolved the Liberator coalition. The phalanx spent itself pursuing towards Cassius's camp; the Thracian troops, the archers on both wings and the Triumvirate's cavalry had already left the field, and the deep formation, stripped of its covering, came apart as it advanced. Cassius and Brutus killed themselves one after the other, their bodies thrown into the Angitis, the Liberator officers were declared public enemies, and the army was disbanded or absorbed; Macedon and the Greek cities returned to Triumvirate rule. The outcome was not a clean victory for anyone. Antony's western front was shattered in the same way, and he gave up Italy and marched east with the remnant of his forces, from 41 BC onward dominating the eastern half of the Roman world. Octavius kept his twenty-eight legions, took the consulship in 37 BC, closed Sextus Pompey out with the naval battles of Mylae and Naulochus in 36 BC, beat Antony again at Actium on 2 September 31 BC, and took Egypt in 30 BC. Seen as a whole, the civil war that began in March 44 BC really settled one question: who was to inherit Caesar. The answer was whoever held the legions and the revenues of Italy, and the name of the republic left the field at Philippi.
